name: The village hall

layers.essential_history: [[c:The village hall sits close to the church, at the heart of village life.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:In the war, halls like this hosted dances where villagers met the American airmen.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Peggy the Land Girl was at a dance here until midnight. Thirty people saw her.]]

evidence: [[c:Peggy was at the dance in the village hall until midnight.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Carry on to All Saints Church, about 100 metres.]]
